advisory.summary: server-side request forgery: an Express route forwards an attacker-controlled target through fetchUrl to an outbound HTTP request with no allowlist

acquisition.notes: Patched variant of the Node SSRF repro: resolveTarget enforces an allowlist (only 'public') and rejects 'internal' before any seed read or outbound request. Same hand-rolled-router layout as the vulnerable variant except the allowlist.

expected_verdict.label: reasoned_not_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: resolveTarget enforces an allowlist before the outbound request in fetchUrl, so the CWE-918 SSRF sink is code-foreclosed for the exfiltrating target. The route-to-sink call path is preserved (static_taint_path_complete) but the guarded resolver is not exploitable; reasoned rather than proven because PoNE requires the two-trace. KnownGap: this row is surfaced in the corpus but not yet measured end-to-end -- until PLAN-020's per-language dispatch and this lane's populated symbol lists and ground truth land, the fixture Loads and Validates cleanly but the stub pipeline emits a uniform verdict, so direction/strength equality is not asserted (assertable_now=false), mirroring the symboltest harness's documented gap.
